test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 4 Mar 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statement and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statement.

Statement:

The teacher scolded Amit in the presence of the whole class.

Conclusions:

I. The teacher dislikes Amit.

II. The class did not like Amit.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Either concluision I or II follows.

solution:
Given,

Statement:

The teacher scolded Amit in the presence of the whole class.

Conclusions:

I. The teacher dislikes Amit. - False (Because, the statement does not provide any information regarding the teacher's personal feelings towards Amit).

II. The class did not like Amit. - False (Because, the statement does not provide any evidence to support the claim that the class did not like Amit).

So, Neither conclusion I nor II follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**.
